text: News & Events Speakers Phil Day Phil Day Configured Things Organisation Configured Things LinkedIn Biography Phil is the Director of Engineering at Configured Things, a startup founded by Alumni from Hewlett Packard Labs to build solutions that can operate resiliently across security domains. He has been a regular speaker at forums such as the IoT Security Foundation conference and CyberCon, and is a contributor to the CHERIoT ecosystem and a technical reviewer for the CHERIoT programmers’ Guide. He has more years experience than he cares to admit to developing and delivering complex distributed systems.
